rationale: Standard Coptic ⲣⲁⲟⲩϣ 'care, concern' (Crum 308a); used here in ⲃⲓ ⲡⲣⲁⲩϣ ⲙ̄- 'bear the care of, take care of.' The body is sustained by the alms-food.
Reduplicated form, listed among eating-vices alongside luxury and drunkenness. The reduplication suggests iterative gulping/swilling. Confidence moderate.
Listed in the same vice-cluster as luxury, gulping, and drunkenness. Etymology uncertain — possibly Lyc form related to ϣⲏⲣ 'satiety' or to a revelry-root. Tentative.
ϩⲱⲛ = 'command, enjoin' (Crum 689a). Construction ⲡⲉ†ϩⲱⲛ ⲙ̄ⲙⲁϥ ⲁⲧⲟⲧⲧⲏⲛⲉ 'this is what I enjoin upon you' (lit. 'commit to your hand') — formal apostolic injunction-formula.
Lyc negative imperative + causative: ⲙ̄ⲡⲱⲣ + ⲧⲣⲉ- 'do not cause/allow.' Standard prohibitive construction.
Lyc verb of motion/intent. With directional ⲁ-: 'draw near to (do something).' Distinct from ⲛⲟⲩ 'go.'
Greek ἐπειδή 'since, because' adopted as Coptic conjunction. Standard Greek loan in Manichaean Coptic.

proposed_english: this speech also / the speech as well
rationale: ⲡⲕⲉ- ('the also/other') + ⲥⲉⲭⲉ ('speech'). Discourse-marker introducing additional/parallel teaching: 'for the speech also we proclaim, that you may proclaim it.'

Abstract noun, possibly Lyc form related to ϩⲁⲣϣ-ϩⲏⲧ 'patient/long-suffering' or to a 'lightness' root. Context (paired with rest of heart and joy of the Mind) supports 'gentleness/equanimity.' Recurs in lines 18 and 31 of this page in identical context.

Tentative parsing of [ϣ]ⲁⲓ̈ϩ̄ⲡⲥ̄ⲣⲁⲕ as Lyc habitual ϣⲁⲓ̈- (1sg) + ⲣ̄- + nominalized ⲡⲥ̄ⲣⲁⲕ where -ⲣⲁⲕ stems from ϩⲣⲁⲕ/ⲍⲣⲁⲕ 'be still.' Confirmed contextually by parallel [ⲉⲓ̈]ϩⲁⲣⲕ in line 28. Confidence low.
